f59aee00a916248d7022042ff6cb62b68e94dd29.summary: A DataBreaches report, published 2023-12-03, on an extortion claim by the AlphV (aka BlackCat) group against Tipalti, a financial technology firm providing accounts payable and payments software. AlphV said it had exfiltrated over 265GB of data since September 2023, claimed an insider was involved, and planned to extort Tipalti, Roblox and Twitch. It posted no proof of its claims. Tipalti said it was investigating the allegation and had not detected any data loss or breach. The report stresses that AlphV's claims are unconfirmed.

dates.what: AlphV claims it was present in Tipalti systems from this date

hedges: DataBreaches reminds readers that AlphV’s claims are unconfirmed.

f57f1bde5e9e4b6c2eea46bb6bae72501b7be4e3.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reports that financially motivated actors, including Storm-0569, Storm-1113, Sangria Tempest and Storm-1674, abused the App Installer protocol handler from mid-November 2023 to deliver malware such as BATLOADER, EugenLoader and DarkGate, often leading to ransomware. Lures included SEO-poisoned software download pages, malicious search ads and Microsoft Teams phishing. Microsoft disabled the handler by default in an App Installer build and lists detections and indicators.
